name: Celestial Oud
description: Celestial Oud captures the essence of elegance and mystery. Fresh aromatic greens and luminous white florals meet warm spices, creating a beautifully balanced opening. As the scent settles, velvety musk, soft powdery accords, rich leather, and precious woods emerge, resting on a warm amber foundation. The result is a graceful, long-lasting fragrance that feels both ethereal and unforgettable.
